description: This file defines the HostEnvSanitizer utility in Swift, responsible for security policies related to environment variable overrides, blocking certain keys and prefixes, sanitizing environment variables, and inspecting override entries for safety.

classes.name: HostEnvOverrideDiagnostics
classes.description: A data structure representing diagnostics for environment variable override checks, including blocked and invalid keys.

methods.name: inspectOverrides
methods.description: Analyzes provided environment variable overrides against security policies, returning diagnostics on blocked or invalid keys.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes environment variables by filtering out blocked keys and applying optional overrides, with special handling for shell wrappers.
